source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES treats INLET1~2 as one literal sensor and truncates fallback inventory; it omits two physical intake paths and measurement planes, rack-ambient/recirculation context, BMC source fields and complete UI/spec evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires separate inlet records, physical mapping and recorded airflow/reference conditions.

old_problem: One range operand or two plausible values could be accepted without mapping INLET1 and INLET2 to distinct GPU-baseboard intake paths and measurement planes. An unrelated rack ambient, downstream local inlet, other board sensor or one average could be substituted despite recirculation and spatial gradients.
disposition_reason: Confirm GB/INLET terminology and bind two stable records and UI rows to their exact physical intake paths, measurement planes and BMC fields. Record the existing rack ambient, power/load, fan, baffle/cable and airflow state and compare each with its location-specific limit or approved co-located reference/gradient without changing cooling.
decision_basis: XLSX row 888, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, internal Script reference, selection manifest, related source cases and historical record were directly reviewed.
Tilde shorthand is not proven query syntax and one result cannot satisfy two independently located intake sensors.
Inlet temperature is meaningful only at a defined plane; rack ambient and downstream baseboard inlet can differ through recirculation, upstream heat and baffle/cable geometry.
ED-15 requires location-specific tolerances, ED-17 preserves fan/thermal logs, ED-20 preserves both inlets and ED-14 keeps dynamic threshold/fan-response coverage separate.

test_case.test_name: Verify GPU-baseboard INLET1 and INLET2 independently by intake path, measurement plane and passive cooling context
test_case.purpose: After confirming GB/INLET terminology, verify two inlet-air records are separately human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, map to the correct GPU-baseboard intake paths, measurement planes and BMC fields, and independently meet applicable value, units, health, threshold/hysteresis and freshness specifications under the recorded passive rack/system cooling state.
required_package: Chassis and GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS build and authoritative GB/INLET terminology
Physical INLET1/INLET2 locations, intake paths, measurement planes and sensor placement/part map
Definition of rack ambient versus chassis or local baseboard inlet plus allowed recirculation/gradient
Per-inlet sensor device, BMC controller/bus/mux/address and exact temperature field
Separate stable SDR/API and Dashboard/Server Health identities for both inlets
Per-location units/scaling, approved limit/reference delta, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, polling/freshness and unavailable rules
Rack ambient/reference method and timestamps plus power/load, fan speeds, airflow direction, baffle/cable and cooling state
Validated protected OOB/API/browser clients and pinned immutable reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual read-only method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear SEL/kernel/GPU/fan/thermal logs, block vents, move baffles/cables/rack doors, change fan policy/speed, add workload, alter thresholds or service hardware. Confirm the two physical intake paths and measurement planes and build a two-row location/BMC-source matrix. Enumerate the complete sensor repository and resolve INLET1 and INLET2 separately; do not use `TEMP_GB_INLET1~2` as one record unless explicitly documented. Review the Script before use. Capture each independent query status, stable identity, value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, health and timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Record synchronized cooling context and use only approved non-obstructive reference placement and per-location gradient/tolerance. Stop without retry on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent identities.
test_case.expected_result: Two distinct records and UI rows map to the documented physical intake paths, measurement planes and BMC fields. Each complete OOB/UI record independently matches its location-specific value/unit/threshold/status/freshness specification and approved reference/gradient under the recorded passive cooling state. Rack ambient, another inlet, PCB/GPU die or an average never substitutes and cooling remains unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires two physical-plane/source identities, separate complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement and an engineer verdict for both inlets using approved per-location limits. One literal range query, one sensor, equality between inlets, generic ambient, label-only match or truncated output cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate/stale identity, out-of-limit value or required threshold/status/UI mismatch is FAIL. Missing location/gradient/spec/reviewed method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; static readings do not validate fan response or threshold events.
safety_gate: Do not clear SEL, kernel, GPU, fan or thermal logs; existing cooling history is relevant evidence.
Do not interpret the range as one record or use one inlet as coverage for the other.
Do not equate rack ambient with a downstream/local inlet or substitute PCB/GPU die/average telemetry.
Do not block vents, move baffles/cables/doors, change fans/load/thresholds or service hardware.
Any reference probe must be non-obstructive, location-approved and time-aligned; it must not disturb intake flow.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Chassis/GPU-baseboard PN/revision, BMC/BIOS, terminology and two-row intake path, measurement-plane, sensor-placement and BMC-source map
Two separate complete raw identities, values, units, threshold capabilities/values, health and synchronized timestamps plus separate Dashboard and Server Health rows
Project per-location limits and rack ambient/reference method with recirculation/gradient rule
Recorded power/load, fan speeds, airflow direction, baffle/cable/rack-door and cooling configuration plus tolerance/update-lag evaluation
Missing/duplicate/swapped/stale/divergent disposition and pinned Script or alternate-method audit
No-clear/no-load/no-fan-or-airflow-change/no-retry proof, final cooling/BMC health and two-inlet engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On intake mapping, BMC-source or reference ambiguity, stale/divergent values, unexpected health change or probe airflow disturbance, stop and preserve both sensors' first evidence plus cooling state. Remove only an authorized non-obstructive reference fixture and use approved read-only diagnostics; any independently authorized cooling change requires its own restoration plan.
